text:
support-jen: Heads-up — Penumbra reported a sudden p95 latency jump on dedicated gce-cluster-4 for model `redwood-7b-quant` since ~10:15 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash/reports/penumbra — p95 went from ~260ms -> ~970ms, throughput steady, error rate unchanged. Raising here for runtime visibility.

sre-oliver: Thanks. Any sample trace IDs or request ids? Also did they change traffic patterns or client SDK versions?

support-jen: Trace id: trace-20260315-9a7b4c. Customer says they started a small config tweak (hybrid batching) around the same time, but we haven't validated causality. No SDK change.

runtime-natasha: Noted. We rolled a kernel-selector heuristic yesterday (commit caf3b8) to prefer fused-attn kernels on the xavier nodes — might be related. Can someone grep kernel-selection logs for that trace id? Look for lines like `kernel_selector: chosen=fused_attn`.

bench-dev: I'll spin up a quick loadgen against a dedicated shard in us-west and run a short profile. Running: ```./loadgen --model redwood-7b-quant --seq 512 --concurrency 18 --dur 120 --endpoint https://dedicated-usw-g4/redwood-7b-quant``` Will paste results in ~10m.

matt: Also check KV cache hit ratio for that customer. If hybrid batching increased average context prefix, KV eviction might cause recompute. cs-amy, can you confirm if they increased prompt lengths or started sending longer system prompts?

cs-amy: They added a 512-token system prompt to some flows — started ~10:00 UTC. Could be correlated.

sre-oliver: Good catch. If KV cache misses spike, tail latency will jump even if throughput looks flat.

runtime-natasha: Triage plan (async): 1) bench-dev reproduces local perf delta, 2) sre-oliver collects kernel selector logs and KV cache hit metrics for gce-cluster-4 (filter by trace id and by tenant), 3) if fused_attn chosen correlates with p95 spike, revert the selector or force fallback to the previous kernel and canary to 5% traffic, 4) support-jen coordinate customer-facing comms.

deploy-bot: deploy-hook: rolled kernel-selector change caf3b8 -> to dedicated pools at 2026-03-14T18:32Z (seq: deploy-7781) :robot_face:

bench-dev: Perf run complete. Summary: baseline (before revert locally) p95=980ms, p50=120ms, ops/s ~75. Forcing `--kernel=fallback` reduces p95 to ~270ms and ops/s ~78. Attaching snippet:
```
# short output
p50 120ms
p95 980ms
ops 75/s
# with forced fallback
p50 110ms
p95 270ms
ops 78/s
```

runtime-natasha: That strongly suggests fused_attn path on this hardware/seq produces tail regressions for long seqs. Two options: A) change selector to prefer fallback for seq>256 on xavier; B) add a safety timeout and fall back at runtime when token-step latency > threshold. I'd prefer A for a fast canary.

matt: Agree with A. We should also check quantized kernel interactions — fused_attn might have higher variance with 4-bit quant kernels. bench-dev, can you test with `--quant=4bit` as well?

bench-dev: Will run 4-bit in next run and update.

sre-oliver: I'm grabbing KV cache eviction traces now. Early look: eviction rate spiked at 10:14 UTC for tenant penumbra-01, correlates with their extra system prompt. I'll share logs shortly (logged to /var/log/kvcache/evictions-20260315.log).

support-jen: I'm telling Penumbra we're investigating and asking for a short window to reproduce while we run canary. They asked for updates in 30m.

runtime-natasha: I'll prepare a quick selector rollback patch to prefer fallback for sequences >256 on xavier nodes and push a canary to 5% traffic. If bench-dev confirms 4-bit also bad, we'll include that condition too. pinging @matt for thumbs on quick rollback.

matt: thumbs up. Prioritize canary rollback. If the canary fixes p95 we roll to 100% and then plan a thorough perf study on fused_attn for long sequences.

bench-dev: 4-bit test shows same pattern — fused_attn p95 ~1.02s, fallback p95 ~280ms.

runtime-natasha: OK great data. I'll open a small PR with the selector tweak and a config flag to opt-in for fused_attn (so we can re-enable after deeper fixes). PR will reference trace-20260315-9a7b4c and bench numbers.

support-jen: Thanks — I'll update Penumbra after canary finishes and put notes into the ticket. If anyone wants to join a quick 15m call once the canary is in (to confirm metrics), reply here and I'll schedule.

sre-oliver: I'm on standby to watch KV metrics during the canary.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: deploy-7809 (selector-rollback-cfg) -> 5% traffic on gce-cluster-4 in 2m :rocket:

support-jen: I'll be on the call if you schedule. Otherwise will post async results.

runtime-natasha: thanks all — leading. Will post PR and canary status updates here. (reaction :eyes:)
